name: Camtono (Exceptional)
description: A camtono is a secured, handle container used for transporting valuable goods. A camtono comes with one key. Without the key, unlocking the camtono requires a DC 27 security kit to force open. It stores 9 lb., not exceeding 3/8 cubic foot, has an AC of 14, and 75 hit points. Destroying the camtono risks damaging any goods stored inside.
